name: pantry-to-plate
description: Inventory-first recipe app: enter a food once, then consuming it is a lookup and a decrement.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build:pg && npm run db:push:pg && npm run seed
scripts.build:web: cd web && npm ci --include=dev && npm run build
